description: Minimal technical analysis library for Python, a Cython core exposed as functions, pandas indicators and polars expressions
rules: There are three stable interfaces over one Cython core: mintalib.functions (works with pandas and polars), mintalib.expressions (polars only), mintalib.indicators (pandas only). Pick the one matching the workflow, do not mix them.
Functions use lower case names: sma, ema, macd. Indicators and expressions use upper case names: SMA, EMA, MACD.

prices is a pandas or polars DataFrame with lower case columns open, high, low, close, volume. series is a pandas or polars series, or a numpy array. Use normalize_prices to fix column name capitalization.
Indicators bind a calculation with its parameters and are called on prices: SMA(20)(prices). Chain them with the | operator: TYPPRICE() | BBANDS(20).

Multi-output indicators (MACD, BBANDS, DMI, DONCHIAN, KELTNER, MACDV, PPO, STOCH) return a DataFrame; select one output with MACD()['macd'], which gives a series indicator. Single-output indicators support alias(name).
as_expr() converts an indicator to a polars expression: no argument on single-output indicators, a required output name on multi-output ones, as in MACD().as_expr('macd').
Core routines in mintalib.core are compiled Cython functions named calc_*. mintalib.functions is the thin stable wrapper over them and is the primary interface.
mintalib.polars and mintalib.pandas register experimental ts accessors. They are not part of the stable API.
Install with pip install mintalib. Wheels carry the compiled extension; pandas and polars are optional and used only by the interfaces that need them.
